title: Daily Storage Rates During Reinstatement Periods — Kestrel Pre-Owned Retail
content:
The daily rate on a storage charge through a statement date for a vehicle repossessed under a Kestrel Pre-Owned Retail Installment Sale Contract follows the reinstatement period running on the statement date. The days are counted in calendar days from the repossession date (not counted) to the statement date (counted); the state reinstatement period is the period recorded on the contract, and the company reinstatement window is the figure for the tier.

| On the statement date | Daily rate |
|---|---|
| Within a recorded state reinstatement period longer than the company reinstatement window for the tier | the statutory-period rate, $12.00 a day |
| Within the company reinstatement window for the tier, and no longer state period is recorded | the window rate, $15.00 a day |
| Any other day | the daily storage fee for the tier |

**Company reinstatement window by tier**

| Tier | Window (calendar days) |
|---|---|
| Kestrel Pre-Owned Retail Tier 5, Tier 4, Tier 3 | 10 |
| Kestrel Pre-Owned Retail Tier 2, Tier 1 | 15 |
| Kestrel Pre-Owned Retail Tier 1+ | 21 |

### Boundaries (hypothetical, Tier 2 contract, window 15)

| State period recorded | Statement date, days after the repossession date | Daily rate |
|---|---|---|
| 30 | 30 | $12.00 — the last day of the state period is within it |
| 30 | 31 | the daily storage fee for the tier |
| 0 | 15 | $15.00 |
| 0 | 16 | the daily storage fee for the tier |
| 12 (not longer than the window) | 14 | $15.00 |
